layout.index.md: plate -> report, record, trace, judge log, repair, termination
layout.records/: one judge record per episode, named by plate, unchanged
layout.logs/traces/<plate>/: the episode's trace split by kind (task.jsonl, prompts.jsonl, model_messages.jsonl, ani_operations.jsonl; index.json says the counts; seq orders them)
layout.logs/judge/: the judge's console output per episode, named by plate
layout.logs/devices/<plate>/: records from 2026-09-16 on: the judge's per-device running configuration at healthy, before_sut and after_sut (one text file per device and moment) and the diffs between them; manifest.json lists what changed

reports/tasks/<plate>/.report.html: the per-task report of scripts/generate_report.py, readable
reports/tasks/<plate>/.report.json: the same report as data (report_version 1.0 plus time_by_phase, tokens, validation, evaluation_parameters, report_information, files); the record's own sections are pointers to the record instead of copies
reports/tasks/<plate>/.summary.json: the numbers: run, evaluations, metrics, operation counts, time by phase, tokens, validation, how the episode counts in the evaluation parameters, the sheet items
reports/tasks/<plate>/.timeline.json: the model's turns and every call in order, with the reasoning spans from the trace
reports/tasks/<plate>/.tool_calls.json: every ANI operation with its arguments and result status
reports/tasks/<plate>/.evaluation_parameters.json: how this episode counts in each of the evaluation parameters
reports/tasks/<plate>/.provenance.json: what ran: model, subject, prompt, thinking, git commit, scenario version
reports/tasks/<plate>/.summary.md: the short Markdown report: verdict, outcome, execution, operations, the subject's conclusion

layout.reports/: summary.txt/json per scenario, evaluation_parameters.json for the whole cell, this file
